scope: Opt-in host dependency export registry on existing hash/path-bound module identity, single observed load/lookup/free lease. No PE loading, DLL code, target graph vertices or general reference counting.

checks.typed_test: actual stdcall int(int,char**,BOOL) callback, exact metadata identity/name/ordinal, lifecycle states, return and all three error slots; synthetic callback response is not a C1 semantic replay.
checks.regressions: Existing module/resource/known-export+IsTNT/module-memory/default/C++ checks all pass. Unconfigured old module behavior unchanged; no broader95 repeat for this additive opt-in slice.

limits: Host adapter validates exact original file/source identity and actual typed ABI; ELF executable membership does not prove a function start or C signature.
Each explicit export lookup is one-shot; missing/repeated inventory denied.
Cached callback addresses remain executable after release; owner callback must validate provider lease before every call.
Dependency-specific input matching/state/IR outputs and complete visible effects remain in CL scripts outside target graph.
No locale or environment state changes in this slice.
